name: fix-m-h2-seat-cas
reason: Wave 4 M-H1/H2 PR2 of three: seat and roster writes (REST spectate, lobby intents, spectator detach, MarkSeatAi) go through one compare-and-swap writer keyed on an optional meta_json revision, so concurrent seat writers merge instead of overwriting.
